name: Judah
playstyle: Natural group leader. Excels at becoming Champion and converting group success into personal Glory.
unique_effect: Give +1 temporary Influence to one other player this round.
upgrade_1_text: When you become Champion of any track, gain +1 extra Glory.
upgrade_2_text: Once per round, when investing in Military, your tokens count as +1.
upgrade_3_text: Once per game, after Influence is revealed, you may move 1 of your tokens to a different track.

name: Benjamin
playstyle: Aggressive combat specialist. High risk, high reward on Military Track.
unique_effect: Gain 1 Goods + 1 Glory. If Military Track is in Low zone, lose 1 Loyalty instead of gaining Glory.
upgrade_1_text: When you become Military Champion, gain +1 Warrior.
upgrade_2_text: Once per round, you may treat 1 Warrior as 2 Influence on the Military Track.
upgrade_3_text: After winning Military Champion, you may immediately take a free Recruit action.

name: Levi
playstyle: Covenant guardian. Strongest at Moral/Spiritual Track and protecting the shared meter.
unique_effect: Raise Covenant Meter by 1 or protect it from the next drop this round.
upgrade_1_text: When you become Moral Champion, raise Covenant Meter by 1.
upgrade_2_text: Once per round, spend 1 Faith to prevent 1 Covenant loss.
upgrade_3_text: Once per game, one track you held counts twice, cancelling a failed track.

name: Ephraim
playstyle: Economic engine and political influencer (Deborah/Abdon tradition).
unique_effect: Gain 2 Goods or 1 Goods + 1 other resource.
upgrade_1_text: Once per round, when investing in Moral Track, gain +1 Faith if you become Champion.
upgrade_2_text: When you unlock this, gain 1 Goods permanently to your starting total for the rest of the game.
upgrade_3_text: Once per round, you may convert 2 Goods into 1 Faith or 1 Warrior.

name: Manasseh
playstyle: Tanky stabilizer. Hard to knock down; strong when tracks fail.
unique_effect: Reduce the Covenant penalty of one failed track by 1 this round.
upgrade_1_text: Once per round, before placing Influence, look at one track’s current special modifier (if any).
upgrade_2_text: Gain +1 Goods when the Provision Track reaches High.
upgrade_3_text: When a track you invested in fails, you lose 1 less Loyalty (minimum 0).

name: Reuben
playstyle: Early momentum and scouting (pastoral warrior tradition, Gilead ties).
unique_effect: Look at the top card of the Crisis modifier deck.
upgrade_1_text: You always place last in the placement phase, seeing how heavily every other tribe has committed before you commit.
upgrade_2_text: When you place at least 2 Influence on one track, name a second track you left empty and gain 1 temporary Supply Influence there.
upgrade_3_text: Once per game, gain +1 Glory for a track where you were not Champion but stood second in Banner strength.

name: Simeon
unique_effect: Gain 1 Glory. If Military is Low, also gain 1 Goods.
upgrade_1_text: When you become Military Champion, gain +1 Warrior.
upgrade_2_text: After a Military Track failure you invested in, you may immediately place 1 token on it next round for free.
upgrade_3_text: Once per round, convert 1 Goods into 1 Warrior or vice versa at no loss.

name: Dan
income_note: Strongman — the only three-resource income, and no Goods at all
playstyle: Trickster / strongman (Samson tradition). Flexible and disruptive.
unique_effect: Discard and redraw one pending Crisis modifier card (once per game).
upgrade_1_text: If all your Banners are on a single track, they count double.
upgrade_2_text: Once per round, you may move 1 of your tokens after all others are revealed.
upgrade_3_text: Once per game, spend 2 Warriors so one track you held counts twice.

name: Naphtali
playstyle: Flexible support (Barak tradition). Good at repositioning and helping others.
unique_effect: Move 1 of your already-placed Influence tokens to a different track (before resolution).
upgrade_1_text: Once per round, after the reveal, you may move 1 of your placed tokens to another track.
upgrade_2_text: When you become Champion, you owe 1 temporary Influence to another tribe — name them and the track at your next placement. It arrives as Supply.
upgrade_3_text: Once per game, after the reveal, name two tracks; your Influence on each counts 1 more.

name: Gad
unique_effect: Protect yourself from the next Loyalty loss this round.
upgrade_1_text: Reduce all Loyalty loss you suffer by 1 (minimum 0).
upgrade_2_text: When Military Track is Low, your tokens on it count as +1.
upgrade_3_text: Once per game, one track you held counts twice, cancelling a failed track.

name: Asher
upgrade_1_text: When Provision Track reaches High, gain +1 extra Goods.
upgrade_2_text: Once per round, when you take a Generate Goods action, gain 1 additional Goods.
upgrade_3_text: Once per game, double the Goods you gain from any single action or Champion reward.

name: Issachar
playstyle: Strategic planner (Tola’s stabilizing role). Information and timing advantage.
unique_effect: Look at the top two Crisis modifier cards and put them back in any order.
upgrade_1_text: Once per round, before placing tokens, look at one track’s current threshold status.
upgrade_2_text: When you become Champion of any track, gain +1 Faith.
upgrade_3_text: Once per game, after all tokens are placed, you may force one other player to move 1 of their tokens.

name: Zebulun
unique_effect: Perform two standard resource conversions this turn.
upgrade_1_text: Once per round, convert 1 Faith ↔ 1 Goods at 1:1.
upgrade_2_text: When you become Provision Champion, gain +1 Glory.
upgrade_3_text: Once per game, after gaining Goods from any source, gain that many again.
